title: Additive derived scalar extension with base scalar compatibility
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings, with B an R-algebra [def-weil-module-base-change]. Choose derived categories D(R) and D(B) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with common morphism universe and module carriers in a universe containing both rings. Assume the ordinary extension functor is additive. There exist an additive functor L:D(R)\to D(B) and a counit L\circ Qh_R\to Qh_B\circ (-\otimes_R B) exhibiting L as the total left derived functor. For every R-complex E, integer i and r\in R, H^i(L(Qh_R(r\,id_E))) equals multiplication by the image of r in B on H^i(L(Qh_R(E))).

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-base-derived-extension-resolution] for the universal pair, its triangulatedness and the counit-isomorphism resolution of each E. A triangulated functor is additive (Mathlib Functor.IsTriangulated additive instance).

Apply [lem-pc-base-derived-extension-scalar] to this same functor and counit, with the resolution clause just obtained. This proves the displayed homology scalar identity. Package the universal property, additivity and the scalar equation into the original existential.
